name: CopilotMCP
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the MMGIS Copilot: exposes every Copilot capability as MCP tools, executing map actions in a live MMGIS browser session through the CopilotMCPBridge component. Disabled unless WITH_COPILOT_MCP=true.

descriptionFull.title: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint at /api/copilot-mcp/mcp. Copilot registry tools (layers, navigation, time, highlighting, statistics, comparison, animation, export, Analysis/Animation tool integration) run in a connected browser session via the AgentChat handlers and return the verified resulting state; Copilot backend operations (planner, raster statistics/difference, layer catalog, region resolver, conversations) run on the server through the Agent plugin's API. Local connections only by default; authenticates with MMGIS sessions or long-term tokens.

envs.WITH_COPILOT_MCP: (string) Set to 'true' to enable the Copilot MCP endpoint and browser bridge [default false]
envs.COPILOT_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTE: (string) Set to 'true' to accept non-loopback MCP/bridge connections [default false]
envs.COPILOT_MCP_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS: (number) Browser long-poll hold time in ms [default 25000]
envs.COPILOT_MCP_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS: (number) Max wait for a browser session to receive and acknowledge a command in ms; unacknowledged commands are withdrawn unexecuted [default 15000]
envs.COPILOT_MCP_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS: (number) Max wait for an acknowledged command's result in ms [default 120000; analysis tools use at least 180000]
envs.COPILOT_MCP_LIVENESS_GRACE_MS: (number) Close a browser session with no open poll, no running command and no request for this long, in ms [default 20000]
